snippet.title: Flightpath - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Try a complete new style of shoot'em up action, combined with story telling and world-building!

Flightpath is a casual, story driven shoot'em up where the choices you make change the outcome of the story.

Steam → https://bit.ly/3AVB0md

Try the demo!
Add to your wishlist!
Coming out January 2023!
